description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete an API key

Deletes one of your API keys for good: it stops working at once and disappears from `list_api_keys`. Use `revoke_api_key` instead when the key should stay listed as revoked. Only keys made in the developer portal or with `POST /developer/api-keys` are deleted here; the access of a connected AI app ends with `disconnect_ai_app`. `id` comes from `list_api_keys`. 404 when no such key of yours exists.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
